inputs.note: data is pre-unit-normalized (knn_graph's normalization path is a no-op here, verified by np.allclose(norms, 1.0)). This fixture was NOT produced by replaying numpy's Mersenne Twister draw-by-draw in the ports; it records the ACTUAL rng_state (drawn first) and rng_states (drawn second, one triple per tree, inside make_forest) that a real check_random_state(42) produces for this call shape. Ports should feed rng_state into nn_descent's RNG and rng_states (row i) into tree i's RP-tree construction RNG, exactly matching make_forest()'s per-tree draw order. This was verified: calling make_forest(data, n_neighbors, n_trees=4, leaf_size=10, RandomState(42) after consuming the first rng_state draw, float32, max_depth=200) then nn_descent(...) with these exact recorded values reproduces knn_graph(data, n_neighbors=10, random_state=42)'s output bit-for-bit (assert checked at fixture-generation time).
